details.description: StarCoder2-15B is a 15-billion-parameter code-generation model from the BigCode project and the successor to the original StarCoder family. It was trained on 600+ programming languages from The Stack v2, using over 4 trillion tokens with grouped-query attention and a 16,384-token context window (with 4,096-token sliding-window attention). Like its predecessors it is a base model, not instruction-tuned, and is intended for code completion rather than following natural-language instructions.
advantages: Scores 46.3% pass@1 on HumanEval and 37.8% on HumanEval+, per the model card.
Trained on 600+ programming languages and 4+ trillion tokens, versus StarCoder's 80+ languages and roughly 1 trillion tokens, per the model card.
Supports a 16,384-token context window with sliding-window attention, per the model card.
disadvantages: Not an instruction-following model; the model card says it performs better with coding context than with natural-language commands like 'write a function that computes the square root.'
The model card warns generated code 'is not guaranteed to work as intended' and may reproduce training data verbatim, requiring attribution.
use_cases: Code completion and generation across 600+ programming languages
